name: CallChatSyn API
description: Let your website, app or AI agent answer customer questions and book appointments with a CallChatSyn business's own answering bot. Create an API key in Dashboard > Developers. Requests count toward the business's plan usage limits. To try it without signing up, use the public demo key ccs_demo_public: it answers as a demo business and bookings are dry runs (200 with booked:false, demo:true), 30 calls per 10 minutes per visitor (shared limit 5,000 a day).
